title: Game levels
description: The level layout of every game that ships levels (src/games/<id>/levels/), read by level-generation-and-solvers' check-levels.mjs. Required as soon as one game has a levels folder. A daily- or endless-only game is an entry with packCount 0, levelsPerPack 0 and no starRule.

games.description: One entry per game with levels (packs, a daily level or an endless run); a game with none of them has no entry.

id.description: The game id: kebab-case, the folder name under src/games.

packCount.description: Number of packs: one pack-<n>.json file each; 0 for a daily- or endless-only game (no plan, no packs).

levelsPerPack.description: Levels in every pack (the plan's levelsPerPack); 0 exactly when packCount is 0.

starRule.description: How every level is rated: 'par' (puzzle games, an exact solver) or 'score' (thresholds; a witness proves games that draw during play). Required with packs; left out when packCount is 0.

daily.description: True when the game has a daily level (LevelsSpec daily kind 'daily').

endless.description: True when the game has an endless run (LevelsSpec endless kind 'endless' at difficulty 100).
